caption: The drawing depicts a cylindrical stoneware jar with a narrow mouth, slightly flared rim, and two small handles on either side near the top. The jar is beige or light tan in color. There is a blue-painted decorative motif on the front, consisting of a bird perched on a curling, abstract branch with several small dots and flourishes. Above the bird design, there is blue stamped text that reads "NEW YORK / STONEWARE CO. / FORT EDWARD, NY" with the number "5" and possibly another letter or symbol below it. A vertical greenish streak appears near the lower left side of the jar. The drawing is set against a plain, off-white background.
title: Jar
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
